## Wave strategy

0. Freeze and publish a reproducible baseline; classify current roots, active dependency isolates, aliases, and body-to-edge mismatches.
1. Enrich active strategic stories, features, decisions, and delivery chains with high-confidence explicit evidence.
2. Normalize legacy edge aliases and repair semantic integrity after ADR acceptance.
3. Backfill recent terminal lineages in changelog-safe batches, then move backward by history epoch.
4. Reconstruct evidence, incident, release, package, and domain relationships from immutable events and linked resources.
5. Verify million-item and federated behavior, sample quality manually, and retain a waiver and uncertainty ledger.

## Safety

No generic-density target. No all-items full dump. No terminal touch outside a dedicated batch. No automatic edge whose source and confidence cannot be explained. A correction appends a superseding event rather than erasing proof.
All-status relationship graph reconstruction: evidence-backed canonicalization and enrichment across every pm item
Reconstruct and enrich the complete historical and active tracker graph in resumable, reviewable waves after semantics and governance are available.

Every item is classified as correctly connected, intentional root, intentional archive or isolate, waived with rationale, or remediation debt with an exact next action; All legacy edge kinds and aliases are mapped to canonical semantics with source evidence; ambiguous relationships remain investigations rather than guessed rewrites; Execution is partitioned into bounded cursor-based waves with snapshots, checkpoints, deterministic ordering, idempotency, resume, rollback-by-new-event, and multi-agent claim boundaries; Active strategic lineages are enriched before terminal history; closed or canceled items change only in dedicated changelog-safe batches coordinated with pm-e9zh; Every mutation records author, timestamp, rationale, source evidence, confidence, previous meaning, and resulting validation evidence in immutable history; Post-wave audits show no new duplicates, dangling endpoints, false order cycles, history drift, or unexplained policy violations and publish graph-quality deltas; The process is benchmarked and token-bounded for one million items and safe under concurrent agents without full-memory or full-output requirements
Classify and correctly connect every item across all lifecycle states while preserving historical truth and avoiding synthetic relationships
The full ecosystem becomes understandable and analyzable as a durable knowledge map rather than only as a hierarchy and archive
Improves context retrieval, lineage, critical paths, impact analysis, duplicate prevention, handoffs, and long-term institutional memory
A checkpointed wave plan, waiver ledger, exact remediation operations, verified graph metrics, and immutable evidence for every change
The baseline identifies meaningful graph debt, but direct bulk mutation before an accepted ontology and policy would create ambiguity and changelog risk

value.author: maintainer-agent
value.text:
Depth baseline measured 2026-07-25, before and after an active-graph enrichment pass. This is the first census that separates semantic edges from hierarchy, which turns out to be the measurement that matters.

Method. Parse every item file directly for parent and dependency edges, build two undirected graphs — one over all edge kinds, one excluding parent and child — and run breadth-first search from the outcome milestone roots over each. Hierarchy-inclusive reachability flatters the graph badly, so it is reported separately and should not be used as a health signal.

Before, over 218 active items: 2 items with zero semantic edges, both of them capability epics (the MCP platform epic and the observability epic — the two hubs least likely to be suspected); 57 items with exactly one; 44 items unreachable from any outcome milestone by semantic edges alone; maximum semantic hop distance 3, with hierarchy carrying almost all of the apparent connectivity.

After: zero items with no semantic edge; 29 with exactly one, of which 27 are Semgrep findings sitting correctly in their deliberate two-level rule-class hub topology and one is the recorded deliberately-shallow item that must never receive fabricated edges; 0 unreachable; semantic hop distance now distributes across 0 to 6, meaning traversal actually traverses. Workspace edge count moved 3,478 to 3,764, entirely in the related kind and entirely on active items.

The finding worth keeping. The audit's isolated-node and degree-at-most-one counters both read zero before this pass, while 44 active items could not reach any strategic outcome without walking a parent edge. Those counters measure whether an item is attached, not whether it is explained. Depth, eccentricity, and shortest typed path to an outcome are the properties that make graph algorithms useful for context assembly, and none of them were being measured. That gap is now owned by pm-bzmeaa.

Constraint honoured. No closed or canceled item was touched in this pass. Terminal lineage remains the exclusive territory of the dedicated changelog-safe waves — pm-lnrk for closed lineage, pm-hnc9w7 for legacy edge hygiene, pm-s5e04g for evidence-derived edges — precisely because touching a terminal item moves its timestamp and drags years-old work into the current release notes.

value.author: harness:claude-code
value.text:
Graph measurement and enrichment pass, 2026-07-25 (second pass of the day). Method is unchanged and remains canonical: parse the .toon corpus directly (dependencies[N]{...} CSV blocks, not the CLI renderer, which is far too slow past two hundred items), build two undirected graphs - all-kinds and semantic-only, meaning every kind except parent and child - and breadth-first search each from the Milestone-type roots. Hierarchy-inclusive reachability always flatters; report semantic-only.

Before this pass: 3,832 workspace edges, 1,811 semantic edges, 36 active items at semantic degree one, semantic depth 6, zero unreachable, zero zero-degree. After: 3,989 workspace edges, 1,872 semantic edges, 28 active items at semantic degree one, semantic depth 6, zero unreachable, zero zero-degree. The 28 remaining degree-one items are exactly the deliberate Semgrep two-level hub topology (members to file representative to rule-class representative) and must never be given fabricated edges.

The substantive change this pass was edge-kind diversity rather than edge count. Two registered relationship kinds had never been used in this workspace: implements had zero edges and verifies had eight. They now carry ten and nineteen. The distinction encoded is worth preserving because graph queries depend on it: `implements` points from a delivery item to the story or accepted decision it realises, so traversing incoming implements edges on a story answers what work would satisfy it; `verifies` points from a gate, benchmark, or harness to the property it supplies evidence for, so traversing incoming verifies edges on an outcome milestone answers what would prove the gate is met. Every outcome milestone now has at least one incoming verifies edge, which makes the milestone ladder traversable in the evidence direction and not only in the ownership direction.

The other structural gain was the consolidation family. Thirteen children of the simplification epic held exactly one semantic edge each - blocked_by the alias shim - which made them indistinguishable from one another to any graph algorithm. Each now carries the defects and owners it actually absorbs (calendar relocation to the duration-parsing defect and the calendar service collision; ops grouping to the three diagnostics-surface defects; annotation facets to the linked-test ordering and stdin conventions, and so on). Those edges are class relationships that already existed in the ledger prose and are now machine-readable.

Standing caution repeated from the first pass: isolate and degree counters measure attachment, not explanation. `pm graph audit` reported zero isolated and zero degree-leq-one active nodes both before and after this pass, while the semantic measurements above moved substantially. Strategic reachability, eccentricity, and shortest typed path to a milestone are the metrics that matter and they are owned by pm-bzmeaa.
